data.narrative:
Black Forest Labs is a Series B–stage AI & Software company seeking valuation. The peer universe comprises one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private-market equivalents at the same or adjacent funding stages, including Scale AI, Figure AI, Reflection AI, Skild AI, and Crusoe Energy.

Stage-progression analysis was inapplicable; the reported $3.25B post-money valuation implied a $6.2B forward value at Series C, exceeding 20x the company's $300M total raised, suggesting data integrity issues at source. Peer-median methodology was therefore the primary triangulation anchor. Across six same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, the median valuation stands at $19.5B, with a measured range of $5.6B (floor, Crusoe Energy at Series C) to $39.0B (ceiling, Figure AI at Series C).

The analysis supports a valuation range of $16.6B to $22.4B, centered on the peer median of $19.5B. Key uncertainties include (1) reliability of the stated $3.25B valuation, which appears misaligned with the $300M capital raised, and (2) stage and sector heterogeneity within the peer set—particularly the inclusion of Series A and Series C companies alongside Series B comparables. The narrow applicability of one method limits conviction; additional revenue multiple or DCF-based triangulation would strengthen the range.
